 BROCast: CFP Rankings, Minnesota, Basketball's Win Over Arizona
 David Woods @ daviddavidwoods 11/06/26 1 Share Share 
 In this edition of the BROCast, Dave and Tracy break down where UCLA fell in the initial College Football Playoff rankings, preview Minnesota, and break down basketball’s season-opening win over Arizona.

 We talked about UCLA coming in at No. 8 in the initial College Football Playoff rankings, and how that sets up a tough road for the remainder of the season, with the Bruins likely able to afford no more than one loss the rest of the season.
 We also previewed the Minnesota game, where a closer inspection of the Golden Gophers revealed that perhaps the way they’ve won games is not particularly sustainable. We both talked about growing more confident about UCLA’s chances the more we looked at Minnesota.
 Finally, we discussed UCLA basketball’s big win over No. 5 Arizona on Monday in Las Vegas to open the season. We talked at length about Nikola Kusturica, Jaylan Petty, and overall physicality and toughness shown by the Bruins in winning that game.
